scientific_integrity: The 84 forbidden triples are deduced from Fano incidence axioms. Two standalone independently implemented exact finite enumerators agree coefficientwise. No extrapolation from finite data to an infinite family is made.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite census only for the 14-vertex Heawood graph; no theorem for arbitrary projective planes and no orbit decomposition; publication priority is best-knowledge and provisional; independent external validation not performed.
title: Exact edge-general-position face and facet polynomials of the Heawood graph
